title: Same distance, same score
notes: PE(m) · PE(n) for every pair of positions. Each diagonal holds one number: distance 1 always scores 3.54, distance 2 always 2.56. The scores do not just fall with distance, though: distance 6 scores 3.78, almost as much as distance 1, because pair 0 has turned nearly a full circle. With 8 numbers, positions far apart can look alike; real models use hundreds.
